QuestInfo.name: Survivor Search
QuestInfo.1: May is happy that some of the noisy Robbies are gone, but she's worried that there may be more survivors than just her. She wants you to search ground zero #e#bfor other survivors#n#k.
QuestInfo.2: You have searched the area all the way to the location where the missile landed, as May requested. Fortunately, you were able to find a male survivor named Bao. How is it that he doesn't even have a tiny scratch on him?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 508,102\nCan proceed to The Dangerous Android quest\n
QuestInfo.0: It seems like #p2082009# has something to say. Go see what it is.

0.0: I was so happy that those Robbies were silenced, but then I began to think that I may be the only survivor left. That's so frightening. I mean, there must be other survivors, right? #b#h0##k, could you investigate the area and see if you can find any?

yes.0: I don't think anyone's around here. How about checking the inner areas? I haven't been near #bground zero#k... Maybe #bsurvivors#k have gathered there?

no.0: #b#h0##k, you don't suppose there are other survivors...do you?

1.0: Who is that? There is a survivor! Here, right here!

yes.0: I'm so relieved that there is another survivor.

npc.0: There must be other survivors, right? #b#h0##k, could you investigate the area and see if you can find anyone?
